title: The empty window looked back 🪟
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 1:23 in the morning, the empty window across the street lit up.

scenes.narration: At 1:23 in the morning, the empty window across the street lit up.
That building has been boarded up since I moved in. Nobody lives there. Nobody has ever lived there.
A figure stood in the light. Not moving. Facing my window.
I turned off my lamp so I could see it better. Same height as me. Same slouch. Same hands hanging at its sides.
I waved. It did not wave back. It raised one arm and pointed. Not at me. At something behind me.
I did not turn around. I watched the glass instead. In my reflection, I could see my bedroom door. It was open. I always close it.
My phone buzzed. A message from my own number. Two words. Do not turn.
Across the street, the figure lowered its arm. Then it reached out and switched off its light.
Now the only light left on the street was behind me. And it was getting brighter.
So tell me. Do you turn around, or keep staring at the window?
